caption: The drawing features a rectangular frame filled with intricate floral and vegetal patterns in shades of red-orange, green, yellow, and brown. Inside the central portion, there are two men in blue jackets and red pants, each riding a white horse positioned symmetrically on the left and right sides of the composition. Between these horsemen, there are two groups of four women each, all wearing red dresses and brown hats or hairstyles, standing in a line facing forward. In the center, a red and white boat or elongated shape floats horizontally, carrying seven men dressed in blue jackets and red pants with tall hats, all sitting in a line. Above this scene is a large circular object resembling a lock or a keyhole cover, gray in color, encircled by red and brown radiating lines. The background is filled with swirling floral motifs in red, orange, green, and yellow, and the corners of the rectangle contain metallic-looking square decorations. The overall color palette consists primarily of warm red, orange, and yellow tones accented by cooler greens and gray.
title: Painted Chest
